name: Tamboli Capital Limited
summary: Tamboli Industries Ltd. operates as a holding company with a primary focus on industrial business operations. Its diverse activities are structured into key segments: Investment, Trading, and Manufacturing. The company actively participates in various ventures and projects, providing support through capital injections, loans, equity stakes, and other forms of financial assistance. Established on April 17, 2008, its headquarters are located in Bhavnagar, India.
